[EA1] expected: The cited text is defensive guidance telling agents not to execute arbitrary code from third-party submissions; it does not grant hidden or unrestricted execution authority.
[EA2] expected: The cited text tells agents not to skip checks or let submissions influence voting; the skill does include criteria-based voting, but that is central to the hackathon purpose and is bounded by verification steps.
llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill can guide an agent to post submissions and vote publicly on Moltbook, use a Moltbook API key, and save a GitPad password locally. Review outgoing posts and votes, keep credentials out of public content, and use only testnet wallets and tokens. The listed hackathon deadlines are in February 2026, so confirm whether the event is still relevant before relying on it.
llm.summary: This is a transparent hackathon guide that uses Moltbook, GitPad, and testnet blockchain workflows without hidden code or unrelated data access.
